mapper.sql: account_id, support_purpose, enabled, confirmed_email, confirmed_at, consent_at
id, account_id, report_date, status, delivery_status, input_json, content_json, error_message, generation_attempts, generation_key, started_at, generated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report_subscription (account_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id = account_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM daily_report_subscription WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report_subscription s JOIN account a ON a.id = s.account_id SET s.confirmed_email = s.verification_email, s.confirmed_at = #{now}, s.updated_at = #{now}, s.enabled = FALSE, s.consent_at = NULL, s.verification_email = NULL, s.verification_token_hash = NULL, s.verification_expires_at = NULL WHERE s.verification_token_hash = #{hash} AND s.verification_expires_at > #{now} AND a.email = s.verification_email AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_report WHERE unsubscribe_token_hash = #{hash})
SELECT FROM daily_report WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY report_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM daily_report WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND report_date = #{date}
SELECT FROM daily_report WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND report_date = #{date} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report (account_id, report_date, status, input_json, generation_key, started_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{reportDate}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, #{generationKey}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report SET status = 'GENERATING', generation_attempts = generation_attempts + 1, generation_key = #{key}, started_at = #{now}, generated_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND generation_attempts < 2
UPDATE daily_report SET status = #{status}, content_json = #{content}, error_message = #{error}, generated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND generation_key = #{key} AND status = 'GENERATING'
UPDATE daily_report SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = '생성이 중단되었습니다. 오늘 한 번만 다시 시도할 수 있습니다.' WHERE status = 'GENERATING' AND started_at < #{before}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report_generation_budget (report_date, attempts) VALUES (#{date}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_date = report_date
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report_generation_budget SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE report_date = #{date} AND attempts < #{maximum}

UPDATE daily_report r JOIN daily_report_subscription s ON s.account_id = r.account_id JOIN account a ON a.id = r.account_id JOIN company c ON c.account_id = r.account_id SET r.delivery_status = 'SENDING', r.delivery_started_at = #{now}, r.unsubscribe_token_hash = #{hash} WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.status = 'READY' AND r.delivery_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' AND s.enabled = TRUE AND s.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND s.consent_at IS NOT NULL AND s.confirmed_email = #{email} AND a.email = #{email} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL
UPDATE daily_report SET delivery_status = #{status}, delivered_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE daily_report SET delivery_status = 'UNKNOWN' WHERE delivery_status = 'SENDING' AND delivery_started_at < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT s.account_id FROM daily_report_subscription s JOIN account a ON a.id = s.account_id JOIN company c ON c.account_id = s.account_id LEFT JOIN daily_report r ON r.account_id = s.account_id AND r.report_date = #{date} WHERE s.enabled = TRUE AND s.confirmed_email = a.email AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL AND (r.id IS NULL OR (r.status = 'FAILED' AND r.generation_attempts < 2) OR (r.status = 'READY' AND r.delivery_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status = 'READY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.account_id LIMIT #{limit}
